Deleting the image. First I'm confirming what's mounted from it and that both off-box extracts are intact:㊢ (deleting the image) The image is deleted. `/` has gone from 85% to 30%, with 2.4 TB free. Before deleting, I checked that both off-box extracts on metameso and lucy pass `zstd -t`. Then I unmounted `/mnt/old` and removed `old-root.img` and nothing else. The ddrescue logs and the 8 GB `/recovery/extract/` are still there. The original old disk is also still attached read-only as `/dev/sda` until hostplane takes it out. The scan's `disk-space`, `recovery-image` and `old-image-readonly` checks all pass now, and `~/README-ZONE-1.1.md` records the deletion.
